dct_description_sm: The Arctic Science and Technology Information System (ASTIS) database describes publications and research projects about northern Canada. ASTIS includes all subjects and covers the three territories, the northern parts of seven provinces and the adjacent marine areas. ASTIS records contain abstracts, detailed subject and geographic indexing terms, and links to publications that are available online.
